figurative_meaning_bn: চাকচিক্য বা ঔজ্জ্বল্যের ভাব প্রকাশক দ্বিত্বশব্দ
figurative_meaning_en: A reduplicative word expressing the sense of sparkle or brightness
similar_in_english: All that glitters is not gold
example_sentences_in_bangla: যাই ঝকঝক করে তাই সোনা নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: This new house is shining brightly.
All that glitters is not gold.
note: Often used in the context of the proverb warning against superficial appearances
